Messages.Author: TigersClaw
Messages.Body:
Angela's text reads:

"Once each time Angelica attempts to block, you may burn X master cards
from your hand to give her +X intercept"

so can I add master cards for intercept as they add stealth? If not
then her ability isn't that good because I can play out more intercept
then needed when she is blocking.

please clarify.

TigersClaw

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Once during an action when Angelica attempts to block you may burn any
number of master cards from your hand. Angelica gets +X intercept where
X is the number of master cards you burned.

You can only do this when Angelica is attempting to block (card text)
and only if Angelica's current intercept is less than the acting
minion's stealth (standard rules).

You can do it only once per action.

You can do it at any time during the action.

--

So can Angelica gain more intecept than the current stealth?

> The reason I ask is that I know that the blocking minion cannot use

> throw down Enhanced Senses and Spirit's touch on a +1 stealth action).
> So can Angelica gain more intecept than the current stealth?

You add intercept only if you need it, but you are not limited to adding
only the intercept you need (i.e., you can add more than you need).

For instance, you can play superior Enhanced Senses when you only need
one more intercept.

And you can burn X masters for Angelica, where X can be more than the
amount of intercept you need (so long as you need at least one).
